segments.en: One database can't hold every order. So which order goes where?
segments.zh: 一個資料庫裝不下所有訂單。那每筆訂單要放哪裡？

segments.en: EncoreThe orders table no longer fits on one machine, so Ana splits it across 4 database servers called shards. A rule decides which shard each order lives on. Pick the rule badly, and adding a 5th shard means moving almost everything, or one shard melts while the others sit idle.
segments.zh: Encore訂單資料表已經塞不進一台機器，所以 Ana 把它拆到 4 台資料庫伺服器上，這些伺服器叫做分片（shard）。由一條規則決定每筆訂單放在哪個分片。規則選得不好，加第 5 個分片就得把幾乎所有資料搬家，或是某個分片快燒掉、其他分片卻閒著。

segments.en: Partitioning
segments.zh: 分割（Partitioning）

segments.en: Splitting one big table into pieces by a rule, for example one piece per month. The pieces can all live in the same database; queries for one month only scan that piece.
segments.zh: 依某條規則把一張大資料表拆成好幾塊，例如每個月一塊。這些分塊可以都放在同一個資料庫裡；查某個月的資料時只需要掃描那一塊。

segments.en: Sharding
segments.zh: 分片（Sharding）

segments.en: Partitioning where the pieces live on different machines. Now you can grow past one server, but the app (or a proxy) must know which shard to ask, and queries across shards get expensive.
segments.zh: 把分割出來的分塊放到不同的機器上。這樣就能突破單一伺服器的上限，但 App（或代理）必須知道要問哪個分片，跨分片的查詢也會變得很昂貴。

segments.en: The one difference
segments.zh: 關鍵差別

segments.en: With hash mod N, changing N changes almost every answer, so adding one shard moves most of the data. Consistent hashing puts shards on a ring; a new shard only takes over the keys next to it, so only about 1 in N keys move.
segments.zh: 用 hash mod N 時，N 一變，幾乎每個答案都跟著變，所以加一個分片就會搬動大部分資料。一致性雜湊（consistent hashing）把分片放在一個環上；新分片只會接手它旁邊的鍵，所以大約只有 N 分之一的鍵會搬動。

segments.en: Split
segments.zh: 拆分

segments.en: Break a big table into pieces by a key. Faster queries and easy cleanup (drop an old month), still one database.
segments.zh: 依某個鍵把大資料表拆成好幾塊。查詢更快、清理更容易（直接丟掉舊的月份），而且仍然是一個資料庫。

segments.en: Spread
segments.zh: 分散

segments.en: Put the pieces on different servers to grow past one machine. The shard key is the most important decision.
segments.zh: 把分塊放到不同的伺服器上，突破單一機器的上限。分片鍵（shard key）是最重要的決定。

segments.en: Grow
segments.zh: 成長

segments.en: Consistent hashing
segments.zh: 一致性雜湊

segments.en: Adding or removing a shard moves only about 1/N of the data, instead of nearly all of it.
segments.zh: 加入或移除一個分片時，只會搬動大約 N 分之一的資料，而不是幾乎全部。

segments.en: The tradeoff
segments.zh: 取捨

segments.en: A good shard key spreads load evenly and matches your most common queries. Hashing spreads load but makes range queries ask every shard; ranges keep related data together but create hot spots. Sharding is hard to undo, so try indexes, caching and replicas (pages 2, 5, 14) first.
segments.zh: 好的分片鍵要能平均分散負載，並且符合你最常用的查詢。雜湊能分散負載，但範圍查詢就得問每個分片；範圍能讓相關資料放在一起，卻會造成熱點。分片很難回頭，所以先試試索引、快取和副本（第 2、5、14 頁）。

segments.zh: `✕ 熱點分片：一個分片持有 ${Math.round(hot * 100)}% 的訂單，也承受同樣比例的流量，因為 12 月是最忙的月份。再加分片也幾乎沒幫助。`

segments.en: `✕ Changing from ${lastChange.from} to ${lastChange.to} shards moved ${Math.round(lastChange.pct * 100)}% of all orders. On a real system that means copying most of the database while it's serving traffic.`

segments.en: `✓ Only ${Math.round(lastChange.pct * 100)}% of orders moved: just the ones whose spot on the ring changed owner.`
segments.zh: `✓ 只有 ${Math.round(lastChange.pct * 100)}% 的訂單搬動了：就是環上那些換了主人的位置。`

segments.en: '✓ Orders are spread evenly across the shards.'
segments.zh: '✓ 訂單平均分散在各個分片上。'

segments.en: '✓ “My orders” for one fan: 1 shard, because orders are placed by fan id.'
segments.zh: '✓ 一位歌迷的「我的訂單」：1 個分片，因為訂單是依歌迷 id 放置的。'

segments.en: `⚠ “My orders” for one fan: all ${n} shards, because orders are placed by month and one fan buys in many months.`
segments.zh: `⚠ 一位歌迷的「我的訂單」：全部 ${n} 個分片，因為訂單是依月份放置的，而一位歌迷會在很多個月份買票。`

segments.en: '✓ “All December orders”: 1 shard, because the months are kept together.'
segments.zh: '✓「所有 12 月的訂單」：1 個分片，因為同一個月份的資料放在一起。'

segments.en: `⚠ “All December orders”: all ${n} shards (scatter-gather), because fan-id hashing scatters December everywhere.`
segments.zh: `⚠「所有 12 月的訂單」：全部 ${n} 個分片（scatter-gather），因為依歌迷 id 雜湊會把 12 月的訂單散布到各處。`

segments.en: 'With Hash mod N, press Add a shard.'
segments.zh: '在雜湊取餘數（mod N）的設定下，按加一個分片。'

segments.en: 'Going from 4 to 5 changes the answer of hash % N for most orders. About 80% of the data moves.'
segments.zh: '從 4 變成 5，大部分訂單的 hash % N 結果都會改變。大約 80% 的資料要搬家。'

segments.en: 'Go Back to 4, switch to Consistent hashing, and add a shard.'
segments.zh: '按回到 4 個，切換成一致性雜湊，再加一個分片。'

segments.en: 'The new shard takes a slice of the ring from its neighbors. Only about 1/5 of the orders move.'
segments.zh: '新分片從鄰居那裡分走環上的一段。只有大約 1/5 的訂單搬動。'

segments.en: 'With consistent hashing, remove a shard.'
segments.zh: '在一致性雜湊的設定下，移除一個分片。'

segments.en: 'Only the removed shard\'s orders move, to their neighbors on the ring. Everything else stays put.'
segments.zh: '只有被移除分片上的訂單會搬到它在環上的鄰居，其他全部不動。'

segments.en: 'Switch to Concert month.'
segments.zh: '切換成演唱會月份。'

segments.en: 'Ranges keep each month together, which is great for month queries. But December lands on one shard, which gets 30%+ of all the traffic.'
segments.zh: '範圍分片讓每個月份的資料放在一起，對月份查詢很好。但 12 月全部落在同一個分片上，它承受了 30% 以上的流量。'

segments.en: '“My orders” for one fan'
segments.zh: '一位歌迷的「我的訂單」'

segments.en: '“All December orders”'
segments.zh: '「所有 12 月的訂單」'

segments.en: 'Hash of fan id (mod N)'
segments.zh: '歌迷 id 雜湊（mod N）'

segments.en: 'Consistent hashing (fan id)'
segments.zh: '一致性雜湊（歌迷 id）'

segments.en: 'Concert month (ranges)'
segments.zh: '演唱會月份（範圍）'

segments.en: '-- partitioning: one table, split by month, one database'
segments.zh: '-- 分割：一張資料表依月份拆分，仍在同一個資料庫'

segments.en: 'CREATE TABLE orders (id bigint, fan_id bigint, concert_month date, …)'
' PARTITION BY RANGE (concert_month);'
'CREATE TABLE orders_2026_12 PARTITION OF orders'
' FOR VALUES FROM (\'2026-12-01\') TO (\'2027-01-01\');'
'// sharding: the app picks the database server'
segments.zh: '// 分片：由 App 選擇要連哪一台資料庫伺服器'

segments.en: 'const ring = new HashRing(["db-a", "db-b", "db-c", "db-d"]);'
'const shard = ring.get(String(fanId));'
'await pools[shard].query("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE fan_id = $1", [fanId]);'
'// a query without the shard key has to ask everyone'
segments.zh: '// 沒有分片鍵的查詢，只能問每一個分片'

segments.en: 'const all = await Promise.all(shards.map(s => s.query("… WHERE month = 12")));'
'Partitioned table'
segments.zh: '分割資料表'

segments.en: 'Postgres splits the table into pieces by month but still treats it as one table. Queries with a month filter only read the matching piece.'
segments.zh: 'Postgres 依月份把資料表拆成好幾塊，但仍把它當成一張表。有月份條件的查詢只會讀取符合的那一塊。'

segments.en: 'One piece'
segments.zh: '一個分塊'

segments.en: 'Each partition is a real table. Dropping an old month is instant, which is much cheaper than DELETE-ing millions of rows.'
segments.zh: '每個分割區都是一張真的資料表。丟掉一個舊月份是瞬間完成的，比 DELETE 數百萬列便宜得多。'

segments.en: 'Consistent hashing ring'
segments.zh: '一致性雜湊環'

segments.en: 'Each server owns many points on a ring (virtual nodes). Adding “db-e” only takes keys from its neighbors. That\'s the lab\'s 20% instead of 80%.'
segments.zh: '每台伺服器在環上擁有許多個點（虛擬節點）。加入「db-e」只會從它的鄰居那裡拿走鍵。這就是實驗室裡的 20% 而不是 80%。'

segments.en: 'Shard key'
segments.zh: '分片鍵'

segments.en: 'Here, fan id: all of one fan\'s orders live together, so “My orders” hits one server.'
segments.zh: '這裡是歌迷 id：同一位歌迷的所有訂單放在一起，所以「我的訂單」只會打到一台伺服器。'

segments.en: 'One shard, one query'
segments.zh: '一個分片，一次查詢'

segments.en: 'A query that includes the shard key goes to exactly one server. Make your most common queries look like this.'
segments.zh: '包含分片鍵的查詢只會送到剛好一台伺服器。讓你最常用的查詢都長這樣。'

segments.en: 'Scatter-gather'
segments.zh: 'Scatter-gather'

segments.en: 'Without the shard key, ask every shard and merge the results. Slow, and it gets slower as you add shards. That\'s the “all shards” case in the lab.'
segments.zh: '沒有分片鍵時，就要問每個分片再合併結果。很慢，而且分片越多越慢。這就是實驗室裡「全部分片」的情況。'

segments.en: 'Encore shards orders with hash(fan_id) % 4. Ben wants to add a 5th shard during the busy season. What should worry him?'
segments.zh: 'Encore 用 hash(fan_id) % 4 替訂單分片。Ben 想在旺季加第 5 個分片。他該擔心什麼？'

segments.en: 'Nothing: only the new shard\'s data moves'
segments.zh: '沒什麼：只有新分片的資料會搬動'

segments.en: 'With mod N, the result changes for most keys when N changes.'
segments.zh: '用 mod N 時，N 一改變，大部分鍵的結果都會跟著改變。'

segments.en: 'About 80% of all orders will need to move between servers'
segments.zh: '大約 80% 的訂單需要在伺服器之間搬家'

segments.en: 'That\'s a huge migration under load. Consistent hashing (or pre-splitting into many small shards) avoids it.'
segments.zh: '這是在負載下進行的大型遷移。一致性雜湊（或預先切成很多小分片）可以避免它。'

segments.en: 'The new shard will be empty forever'
segments.zh: '新分片會永遠是空的'

segments.en: 'It gets its share, but by reshuffling almost everyone else\'s data too.'
segments.zh: '它會分到自己的份，只是代價是把幾乎所有人的資料也重新洗牌一遍。'

segments.en: 'Orders are sharded by concert date. During the reunion tour on-sale, one database is at 100% CPU and the rest are idle. Why?'
segments.zh: '訂單依演唱會日期分片。重聚巡演開賣時，一台資料庫 CPU 到 100%，其他都閒著。為什麼？'

segments.en: 'The busy server is broken'
segments.zh: '那台忙碌的伺服器壞了'

segments.en: 'It\'s working fine. It just owns all the hot data.'
segments.zh: '它運作得很好，只是擁有了所有熱門資料。'

segments.en: 'Range sharding put every reunion-tour order on the same shard: a hot shard'
segments.zh: '範圍分片把所有重聚巡演的訂單都放在同一個分片：熱點分片'

segments.en: 'Pick a key that spreads the busiest traffic, like fan id or order id hashed, and keep date ranges for partitioning within a shard.'
segments.zh: '選一個能分散最忙流量的鍵，例如雜湊後的歌迷 id 或訂單 id，日期範圍則留給分片內部的分割使用。'

segments.en: 'There are too few shards'
segments.zh: '分片太少了'

segments.en: 'More shards wouldn\'t split December, which still lands in one range.'
segments.zh: '再多分片也拆不開 12 月，它仍然落在同一個範圍裡。'

segments.en: 'What\'s the difference between partitioning and sharding?'
segments.zh: '分割和分片有什麼不同？'

segments.en: 'They\'re different words for the same thing'
segments.zh: '它們是同一件事的不同說法'

segments.en: 'They\'re related, but there\'s a key difference.'
segments.zh: '它們有關係，但有一個關鍵差別。'

segments.en: 'Partitioning splits a table into pieces; sharding puts those pieces on different machines'
segments.zh: '分割是把資料表拆成好幾塊；分片是把這些分塊放到不同的機器上'

segments.en: 'You can partition inside one database. Sharding adds the distributed part: routing, cross-shard queries, rebalancing.'
segments.zh: '你可以在一個資料庫內分割。分片多了分散式的部分：路由、跨分片查詢、重新平衡。'

segments.en: 'Sharding is for reads and partitioning is for writes'
segments.zh: '分片是給讀取用的，分割是給寫入用的'

segments.en: 'Both affect reads and writes. The difference is one machine vs many.'
segments.zh: '兩者都會影響讀取和寫入。差別在於一台機器還是多台。'
